en_title: Canadian Politician Petitions Government to Help BioWare Buy Its Way From Under EA
cn_title: 加拿大政界人士向政府发起请愿，寻求帮助BioWare出资摆脱EA的控制
opus_summary: EA关闭BioWare后，加拿大议员Don Davies支持一项官方请愿，呼吁政府提供资金，帮助工作室取得独立及其知识产权所有权。请愿签名已超过提交众议院讨论所需的500人门槛，但政府是否会采取行动仍有待观察。

paragraphs.en: Update: Canadian MP Don Davies has provided comment on the BioWare petition:
paragraphs.cn: 更新：加拿大国会议员Don Davies就BioWare请愿发表了评论：

paragraphs.en: “BioWare has cultivated an international following from their renowned video game franchises like Mass Effect, Baldur’s Gate, and Dragon Age. Canada’s video game industry creates some of our most important cultural exports, and BioWare was among our biggest success stories.
paragraphs.cn: 「BioWare凭借《质量效应》《博德之门》和《龙腾世纪》等知名电子游戏系列，在国际上培养了一批拥趸。加拿大电子游戏产业创造了我国一些最重要的文化出口产品，而BioWare曾是我们最成功的案例之一。

paragraphs.en: Electronic Arts, their American parent company, was never invested in the success of BioWare since they purchased the studio as part of a larger acquisition in 2007. This is a pattern with video game publishers like EA. They buy smaller developers, set unrealistic timelines, overwork their employees, and meddle in the development process, resulting in poorer quality games. Then, when sales fail to meet expectations, they blame the developers, lay off workers, and eventually shut down the studio for short-term profit.
paragraphs.cn: 自2007年作为一项更大规模收购的一部分买下这家工作室以来，其美国母公司EA从未真正关心过BioWare能否成功。这是EA等电子游戏发行商的一贯做法。他们收购规模较小的开发商，制定不切实际的时间表，让员工超负荷工作，并干预开发流程，导致游戏质量下降。然后，当销量不及预期时，他们就责怪开发者、裁撤员工，最终为了短期利润关闭工作室。

paragraphs.en: New Democrats want BioWare to stay in business, preferably under Canadian control. We believe that the employees at BioWare ought to have the first opportunity to buy back their studio and continue making the games that fans love. The petition primarily asks the federal government to provide the required capital. This is absolutely possible. Our goal with the petition is to demonstrate just how many Canadians believe this is a worthwhile investment in our entertainment industry.”
paragraphs.cn: 新民主党人希望BioWare能够继续运营，最好是在加拿大的控制之下。我们认为，BioWare的员工应当获得优先机会，买回他们的工作室，继续制作粉丝喜爱的游戏。这份请愿主要要求联邦政府提供所需资金。这绝对是可能的。我们发起请愿的目标，是展示究竟有多少加拿大人认为这是一项对我国娱乐产业的值得投资。」

paragraphs.en: It's already been a couple of weeks since EA shut down BioWare , but the fight to save the studio is still picking up steam. And now, after a fanmade petition reached 300,000 signatures , a Canadian politician has started an official government petition to save the Mass Effect developer.
paragraphs.cn: EA关闭BioWare已经过去了几周，但拯救这家工作室的行动仍在不断升温。如今，在一份由粉丝发起的请愿获得30万个签名后，一名加拿大政界人士发起了一份正式的政府请愿，希望拯救这家《质量效应》开发商。

paragraphs.en: Petition e-7898 was initiated by Burnaby, British Columbia resident Brendan Routh, and sponsored by Vancouver Kingsway MP Don Davies. The petition primarily calls upon the Canadian government to provide BioWare with the necessary capital to secure independence and ownership of its intellectual property. However, it further asks the government to protect Canadian businesses from "being dictated by American and foreign corporate interests."
paragraphs.cn: e-7898号请愿由不列颠哥伦比亚省Burnaby居民Brendan Routh发起，并由Vancouver Kingsway选区国会议员Don Davies支持提交。请愿主要呼吁加拿大政府向BioWare提供必要资金，以确保其获得独立地位及自身知识产权的所有权。此外，请愿还要求政府保护加拿大企业，避免其「受到美国及外国企业利益的摆布」。

paragraphs.en: The petition also asks the government to "champion the values of inclusivity, tolerance, democracy, justice, and civil rights at the centre of Canada's national identity by preserving BioWare's invaluable contribution to the global entertainment industry."
paragraphs.cn: 请愿还要求政府「通过保全BioWare对全球娱乐产业的宝贵贡献，捍卫加拿大国家认同核心的包容、宽容、民主、正义和公民权利等价值观」。

paragraphs.en: At the time of writing, the petition has already racked up 2,861 signatures. And while that's a far cry from the 307,000 signatures on the change.org petition, the Canadian government only requires that 500 people sign it before it's brought before the House of Commons for discussion. And while it will be presented to the House of Commons, it remains to be seen whether or not the Canadian government will actually act on it.
paragraphs.cn: 截至本文撰写时，这份请愿已获得2,861个签名。虽然这与change.org请愿的307,000个签名相差甚远，但加拿大政府只要求有500人签名，就能将请愿提交下议院讨论。尽管它将被提交下议院，但加拿大政府是否真的会对此采取行动，还有待观察。

paragraphs.en: However, Don Davies has taken to Bluesky to argue the petition's merits. In a post, Davies argues "BioWare’s US parent company, EA, has decided to close the studio. These publishers buy developers, run them into the ground, and rip them apart for profit. There's a pattern of US companies buying Canadian businesses and shutting them down, costing Canadians their jobs."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，Don Davies已在Bluesky上阐述这份请愿的理由。Davies在一篇帖子中表示：「BioWare的美国母公司EA决定关闭这家工作室。这些发行商收购开发商，把他们搞垮，再为了利润将他们拆得七零八落。美国公司收购加拿大企业并将其关闭的情况屡见不鲜，导致加拿大人失去工作。」

paragraphs.en: In a followup post, Davies continues: "The developers at BioWare know how to run their studio. They know how to make the games that fans love. They should be given the first opportunity – and the federal support – to buy it and run it themselves."
paragraphs.cn: Davies在后续帖子中继续写道：「BioWare的开发者知道如何经营自己的工作室。他们知道如何制作粉丝喜爱的游戏。他们应当获得优先机会以及联邦政府的支持，买下工作室并自行经营。」

paragraphs.en: This petition comes a little over a week after another Canadian politician, Avi Lewis, spoke out about the closure, and floated the idea of the Canadian government helping BioWare gain its independence from EA. But, now that there's a petition that has crossed its signature threshold, there's actually a slim possibility that something is going to happen.
paragraphs.cn: 就在这份请愿发起的一周多前，另一名加拿大政界人士Avi Lewis曾就工作室关闭一事发声，并提出了加拿大政府帮助BioWare摆脱EA、获得独立的想法。但现在，一份请愿的签名数已经超过门槛，事情实际上有了一丝取得进展的可能。

paragraphs.en: I've reached out to Don Davies for comment, and I'll update this article if I hear anything. But, who knows; maybe there's a chance that something will come of that incredible leaked Mass Effect 5 trailer, after all.
paragraphs.cn: 我已联系Don Davies寻求评论，如果得到任何回应，我会更新本文。不过，谁知道呢；那支令人惊叹的《质量效应5》泄露预告片或许终究还有机会迎来后续。
